summary.text: An infant son of Thyestes who was brutally murdered by Atreus and served to his father at a banquet.

story.text: To exact his terrible revenge upon his brother Thyestes for seducing his wife Aerope, Atreus feigned a reconciliation. He secretly slaughtered Thyestes' infant sons—Aglaus, Callileon, and Orchomenus—boiled their flesh, and served it to Thyestes at a banquet.
